instruction: In the repository /luxon (a JS library, Luxon), run the full pre-existing test suite and report results. Do NOT modify any files. Commands: `cd /luxon && npx jest 2>&1 | tail -60` (if that fails try `npm test -- --ci 2>&1 | tail -80`). Report: (1) the exact command used, (2) total number of test suites and tests passed/failed, (3) the full list of failing test names with their file paths and the failure messages, (4) whether any test suite failed to run at all. Be concise but complete about failures.

Repo /luxon (Luxon JS library). URGENT, small edit, do it first and fast. In src/duration.js the unit-conversion matrices are missing the years<->quarters entry, so `Duration.fromObject({ years: 1 }).as("quarters")` and `Duration.fromObject({ years: 1, quarters: 1 }).normalize()` return NaN. FIX: add `quarters: 4,` as the FIRST property of the `years` object in BOTH `casualMatrix` (around line 32) and `accurateMatrix` (around line 64) in src/duration.js, i.e. `years: { quarters: 4, months: 12, ... }`. Do not change anything else. Then run `cd /luxon && npx jest test/duration 2>&1 | tail -20` and `cd /luxon && npx jest --testPathIgnorePatterns 'tmp-' 2>&1 | tail -15` and report: the edit, whether all test/duration suites pass, and the full-suite pass/fail counts (the only acceptable failures are 2 French-locale/ICU tests in test/datetime/toFormat.test.js). Report immediately and concisely.
